name: finchain-sepolia
source: The addresses and the tender are those of the two-agent business loop recorded on 2026-11-13 in the finchain repository (manifests/evidence/business-loop-2026-11-13.json, og-finchain-2026-11-13.json): the OG minted tender 5 through its account, cell-b delivered through its account, a hashlock verifier settled it.
This file holds public addresses only. The check reads the chain and compares; it does not rely on the recorded description.
